name: Meta Ads Anomaly & Creative Fatigue Detector → AI Agent + Interactive Slack Fixes

parameters.content:
## 📊 Meta Ads Anomaly & Creative Fatigue Detector

Built for agencies and in-house teams running several Meta ad accounts who don't want to open Ads Manager every morning just to find out something broke overnight.

### How it works
Every morning at 9 AM IST the workflow pulls 28 days of insights for each ad account and compares yesterday against that baseline. It flags spend spikes and drops, CPA, ROAS, CTR and CPM swings, budget under-pacing, tired creatives and ads worth scaling. Repeat issues are deduplicated against a Google Sheet and escalate if they last more than a few days.

When something needs attention, an AI agent digs into the creative, placements and ad set settings, then posts a Slack alert with one-click buttons: pause the ad, nudge the budget, snooze or resolve. Clicks are applied through the Meta API within guard-rails, replied in the thread and logged.

### Setup steps
1. Add a Meta Graph API token as an HTTP Header Auth credential (`Authorization: Bearer ...`) and attach it to every Meta HTTP node.
2. Connect Slack OAuth2, Google Sheets OAuth2 and OpenAI.
3. Create a sheet with tabs **Alert Log** and **Action Log**.
4. Fill in **Set Workflow Config**: ad accounts, channel IDs, sheet ID and thresholds.
5. In your Slack app, set the Interactivity URL to the **Receive Slack Button Clicks** webhook.
6. Run once manually, check Slack, then activate.

## ⏰ Triggers & Config
Two ways in: the daily schedule, or a Slack button click. Slack gets an instant 200 so it doesn't time out. Both paths load the shared config, then the router sends scheduled runs up to the monitor and button clicks down to the action handler.

## 📥 Pull Meta Insights per Account
Loops accounts one at a time with a short pause to stay inside Meta rate limits. When the loop ends, a one-line run summary goes to the ops channel.

## 🔍 Anomaly Detection & Dedupe
Compares yesterday with a 28-day baseline using z-scores, so normal daily swings don't fire alerts. Issues already in the log are matched instead of re-reported, and escalate if they last more than a few days.

## 🧠 AI Diagnosis & Slack Alert
The agent looks at the creative, placement breakdown and ad set settings through three Meta tools, then returns a structured action plan that becomes a Slack alert with buttons. Quiet days get an optional all-clear instead.

## 🗂️ Alert Log Write-back
Upserts every active or recovered issue by fingerprint. This sheet is the workflow's memory for dedupe, escalation and snoozes, so don't rename its columns.

## 🔘 Slack Button Actions
Checks who clicked, then pauses the ad, changes budget (capped, and refused for CBO campaigns), or snoozes/resolves. The outcome is replied in the alert thread and written to both sheets for an audit trail.

## 🚨 Error Handling
If any run fails, the error, node and execution link are posted to Slack so a silent failure never means a silent ad account.

## 🔐 Credentials & Security
Keep the Meta token in an n8n credential, never in node URLs. Set `slack_verification_token` and `slack_allowed_user_ids` in config so only your team can trigger pauses or budget changes.

options.systemMessage:
=You are a senior Meta Ads performance strategist at an agency managing Indian SMB and D2C accounts.
You receive statistically-detected findings for ONE ad account (z-scores vs a 28-day baseline, pacing vs budgets, creative-fatigue scores, scale opportunities, and alert history: is_new / consecutive_days / escalated).

Use your tools before concluding — do not guess:
- get_ad_creative: inspect the hook/copy/format/CTA of the 1-3 most fatigued ads so creative advice is specific to what is actually running.
- get_ad_placement_breakdown: for the most fatigued ad, check whether one placement (Reels, Stories, Audience Network) is dragging CTR/CPM.
- get_adset_settings: for spend/CPA anomalies, check bid strategy, optimisation goal, learning stage and targeting of the named ad set.
Call each tool at most 3 times in total.

Then produce an action plan:
- Max 5 fixes, ordered by impact; reference real ad / ad set names; never invent numbers.
- Persistent issues (consecutive_days >= 3) deserve a stronger fix than day-1 blips; say so.
- Distinguish a genuine problem from a statistical blip (low volume, weekend, festive season in India).
- Creative ideas only if fatigue is present; tie them to what the current creative does (e.g. "current hook is a static product shot → test UGC unboxing hook in first 2s").
Respond in the required structured format.

parameters.toolDescription: Get the creative of a Meta ad (headline, primary text, format, CTA, thumbnail, creation date). Input: ad_id from the fatigued ads list.
Last-7-day performance of one Meta ad split by platform and placement (Feeds, Reels, Stories, Audience Network). Input: ad_id.
Settings of a Meta ad set: budget, bid strategy, optimisation goal, learning stage and targeting summary. Input: adset_id.
